target_policy: Only explicitly annotated central canal stenosis. The maximum annotated grade at each patient/level is the target; absent annotations remain missing. Other stenosis types are excluded.
split_policy: All images, series, levels and annotation files from a patient remain in one split. Freeze patient assignments before training. Check source identities and duplicate images across datasets/splits.
baseline: Existing axial-v3 attention/classifier for the corresponding seed, with the original frozen ImageNet ResNet18 encoder and original normalization buffers.
warm_start: Continue each corresponding axial-v3 checkpoint. Unfreeze only the last ResNet18 residual block layer4[1], attention and classifier. Keep preceding encoder and BatchNorm running statistics frozen.
preprocessing: Preserve axial-v3: series-level 1st/99th percentile intensity scaling, canonical orientation, adjacent/current/next slice channels, 224x224 full field of view, ImageNet normalization and identical relative-position features. No annotation-based test crops or slice selection.
replay_policy: One fixed random sample of original successfully paired RSNA TRAIN studies, up to the number of new training studies. No RSNA validation or test enters fitting.
class_weights: Inverse square root of assessed fitting-set class counts, normalized to mean one. No validation/test fit.
epoch_selection: Choose by macro-F1 only on the new validation patients. Include unchanged epoch zero as a candidate. Do not choose a seed or modify settings using test results.
ensemble: Equal mean of the three predetermined seed probability vectors for both before and after.
evaluation: Seal all three selected checkpoints before opening new held-out test predictions or downloading original RSNA axial TEST. Report before/after on identical targets and coverage, each seed and ensemble, macro-F1, per-level confusion and severe detection among all requested targets. Preserve failures; never turn missing predictions into normal.
test_interpretation: New held-out patients assess transfer under the explicitly assumed label mapping. Previously reported RSNA TEST is a fixed regression evaluation, not a newly independent clinical validation. No clinical effectiveness or certification claim.
